coefficient_subscript_confusion.feedback: Coefficients multiply whole formulae; subscripts are part of the formula and must not be changed when balancing.
coefficient_subscript_confusion.calm_prompt: Count atoms on each side before changing any numbers.

unbalanced_equation_accepted.feedback: A chemical equation must be balanced — same number of each type of atom on both sides.
unbalanced_equation_accepted.calm_prompt: Use the hit-and-trial method: start with the most complex molecule.

oxidation_reduction_swap.feedback: Oxidation is gain of oxygen (or loss of hydrogen); reduction is loss of oxygen (or gain of hydrogen).
oxidation_reduction_swap.calm_prompt: OIL RIG can help: Oxidation Is Loss (of electrons), Reduction Is Gain.

displacement_reactivity_error.feedback: A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its salt solution.
displacement_reactivity_error.calm_prompt: Compare reactivity series: Zn > Fe > Cu.

physical_vs_chemical_change.feedback: A chemical change forms new substances with different properties; physical change does not.
physical_vs_chemical_change.calm_prompt: Ask: can I get the original substance back easily?
